description: PR renames the "payments" key of the for_each queues map in terraform.tfvars to "payments-v2"; the key is part of the queue names, so Terraform destroys the live prod-payments work queue and its DLQ (delete_because_each_key) and creates new prod-payments-v2 queues. Noise: a new loyalty-points queue set, orders visibility timeout 60 -> 90, Team/Runbook default tags, producer/consumer IAM policies re-rendered.

material.why: The live prod-payments queue is deleted: payment events still in flight (14-day retention) are lost, and producers/consumers that address the queue by URL/ARN break until redeployed against prod-payments-v2. Lost payment messages are unrecoverable money-moving work, hence critical rather than high.
The payments dead-letter queue is deleted too: failed payment messages awaiting investigation/redrive are lost.
